author: Charlotte Mary Yonge

publisher: 'Chez Jacob & Johnson, Impremeurs, a Winchester: et chez Harris, St. Paul\''s

One of CMY’s rarest works, there are copies at Girton College, Cambridge and in the Bodleian Library.

The characters reappear under other names in Scenes and Characters.

Although it was printed privately, it seems to have been advertised for sale by Simpkin, who may perhaps have bought what was left of the stock.
